answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to lock a refundable bond before it can earn: a newcomer stakes tokens that are slashed if peers prove fraud, so one attacker running a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand bonds. Like a lantern hung above a nectar trade, the bond makes identity visible and costly - cheap to be honest, ruinous to fake at scale. The defense holds only while the stake stays above the delta between honest earnings and cheating profit; set it below that gap and fake identities turn profitable.
